profile.headline: Software Engineer at Finix
profile.summary: Back-end developer with a passion for creating applications that are reliable and user-friendly. Problem solver with a proven record of identifying deficiencies and designing innovative strategies for improvement as a Teach for America alumna. Skilled in Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

positions.title: Apprentice - Engineering Immersion Program
positions.description: Graduated from a full-stack web development program. The course gave me in-depth instruction and hands-on practice in HTML and CSS, jQuery, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and algorithms and data structures.

positions.title: 9th Grade English Teacher
positions.description: Led discourse-driven lessons on classic literature and argumentative writing technique.

positions.title: 5th Grade Teacher
positions.description: Planned objective-driven lessons based on my students' learning data, targeting their individual needs in phonics, reading comprehension, the writing process, and science.

positions.title: Business and Events Assistant
positions.description: Maintained the Student Center website, Facebook, and Twitter pages to distribute information; recorded and organized expenses and reimbursements using accounting software; billed external clients and internal departments using Excel spreadsheets for yearly revenues of $120,000

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Analyzed documents such as newspapers and school records to construct a history of Jewish students at Rice, and then reported to my faculty supervisor to finalize the publication for the Rice Centennial celebration.

company.name: Woodson Research Center at Rice University

positions.title: Student Manager
positions.description:
Directed day-to-day operations including the preparation of food along state and federal health guidelines
Conducted new hire interviews, and organized payroll and schedules for 10 student employees
Initiated as a regular employee and was promoted twice based on leadership among coworkers
